verdict.rationale: Google ADK is a code-first framework, so its public API is the SDK itself. The docs show agents defined programmatically through documented classes such as `Agent(name, model, instruction, tools)`, offered in Python, TypeScript, Go, Java and Kotlin. A documented `adk` CLI covers run, web, eval and deploy, and the docs say deployed agents can be queried in production. missing for 10: an evidenced API reference or a documented HTTP/REST interface for deployed agents (OpenAPI probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
